# world-tag legacy inventory -- the EXACT set of files grandfathered out of
# the {World: ...} / [Ring N / NAME] requirement enforced by
# scripts/checks/check_world_tags.py.
#
# This file replaced the open-ended libs/ra8_hal/ + tests/ PREFIX exemption,
# which let a brand-new untagged file under either root pass the strict gate
# despite the rule saying new code has no route into the exemption.
#
# Membership is by exact repo-relative path. Adding a path here is a scope
# change to a blocking gate and is reviewed like any other suppression; the
# gate itself only ever removes work from this list:
#
#   * tag a file and its row goes stale, and the gate says so
#   * delete a file and its row goes stale, and the gate says so
#
# so the inventory shrinks and can never quietly grow. Burning it to zero
# closes the second half of #842.
#
# No regeneration step: tag the file, drop its line.
